There is no writer: edit this file by hand with the measured value. It is NOT package data (unlike architecture_baseline.json, which maxim --audit-architecture reads at runtime): only the test reads it, so shipping it in the wheel would be a packaging requirement nothing consumes. Note the strict equality: a pure reformat that shortens a function reddens the fast suite with a 'it shrank' message — deliberate, so a ceiling can never quietly overstate the debt.
